thread:
emma: FYI customer hit a hard validation error when our OA-compat layer forwarded a tool call. 422 validation.
liam: Can you paste the request + response?
emma: Pasting redacted snippets. Repro in prod: 
```json
POST /v1/call-tool
{
  "tool": "invoice_action",
  "args": "{\"invoice_id\":12345,\"action\":1}"
}
```
emma: Response from model (OA-compatible) was: 
```json
{
  "tool_response": {
    "status": 200,
    "result": {
      "action": 1,    // expected string enum like "approve" or "reject"
      "note": null
    }
  }
}
```
emma: Our schema validator throws because `action` is enum[strings].
maya: Huh — model returned numeric enum and the customer also encoded `args` as a JSON string (stringified body). double trouble.
liam: Is this a drifted model behavior or our envelope parsing?
emma: Repro steps attached to the Zendesk ticket #C-16342. Steps: 1) send tool call with args as string 2) model returns numeric enum 3) validator rejects. Happens intermittently (~1/50 calls).
alex: ops-bot, can you check if any deploys/rollbacks touched oa-compat last 24h?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: No OA-compat deploys in last 24h. Last change was 3 days ago by @maya (ml).
maya: I added a loose parser for some legacy models but didn't change enum handling. Might be the model variant returning index-based enums.
liam: Quick mitigation options: 
- accept numeric enums in normalizer (coerce int->string mapping table)
- accept `args` as either object or stringified JSON (attempt JSON.parse if string)
- add a temporary request-side prevalidation that normalizes before schema validation
emma: Customer needs a hotfix; they hit this in production flows. How fast can we ship a compatibility shim?
liam: I can push a small change to the compatibility layer to try parse-string-args + coerce enums. Will add feature flag `compat.loose_enum_coercion=true`. Can roll to canary in 30m.
maya: I'll add model-side normalization too (map indices from recent model variants to expected enum labels). I'll also add logging with model_variant and sequence_id.
alex: Support ops checklist: 1) enable feature flag on canary 2) route the affected org to canary 3) monitor errors/latency 4) if green, roll to stable.
emma: Ticket updated with workaround and ETA. Customer notified: temporary mitigation enabled if they opt in.
liam: Note: we should also update our OA-compat docs and schema examples to mention numeric enums and stringified args as real-world deviations.
emma: +1. Also adding a regression test to catch this shape in our CI.
alex: I'll own the rollout & postmortem. Assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml.
liam: PR will include a small mapping table and unit tests. I'll tag you @emma for QA and @maya for model mapping review.
emma: Thanks. cc @ops-bot for telemetry alerting. :eyes:
ops-bot: alert created: support.toolcall.schema_errors for org=acct-568 on rule=enum_mismatch
liam: After canary, follow-up: remove mapping after model upgrades? track with feature flag expiry.
emma: Closing loop once error rate <0.1% for 24h.
alex: thanks all. :thumbsup:
